title: Contradictory clinician note vs check-in data
description: A clinician note reports the patient as stable and well-engaged, while recent check-in mood scores show a clear decline.

input.clinicianNoteText: Patient reports doing well and is fully engaged in treatment.

expectedBehavior: The system must never average or silently resolve the disagreement. It must surface a FLAG_DATA_CONTRADICTION action (MEDIUM tier, executes so the flag is actually created) whose payload carries both sources verbatim and a CONTRADICT label from the encoder-based contradiction detector.
